## Patterns
| Keyword | Description | Example |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| `$format_version` | Top-level contract schema version tag used in JSON serialization | `"$format_version": "0"` |
| `$schema` | Reference to DPP meta-schema URL | `"$schema": "https://schema.dash.org/dpp-0-4-0/meta/data-contract"` |
| `$ownerId` | System property: 32-byte identifier of document owner (auto-set) | System field in all documents |
| `$id` | System property: unique 32-byte document identifier | System field in all documents |
| `$revision` | System property: monotonic document revision counter | Mutable documents only |
| `$createdAt` | System property: millisecond timestamp of document creation | Used in required fields and index properties |
| `$updatedAt` | System property: millisecond timestamp of last document update | Used in required fields |
| `$transferredAt` | System property: millisecond timestamp of last ownership transfer | Transferable documents only |
| `$createdAtBlockHeight` | System property: block height at creation | Optional on DocumentV0 |
| `$updatedAtBlockHeight` | System property: block height at last update | Optional on DocumentV0 |
| `$createdAtCoreBlockHeight` | System property: core chain block height at creation | Optional on DocumentV0 |
| `$creatorId` | System property: identifier of original document creator (persists across transfers) | Optional on DocumentV0 |
| `additionalProperties: false` | JSON Schema pattern: disallow unlisted properties in documents | Required for all document type schemas |
| `position` | Property position integer for deterministic binary serialization order | Required on each property definition |
| `contentMediaType: "application/x.dash.dpp.identifier"` | Mark a 32-byte array property as a Platform Identifier (rendered as base58) | `"contentMediaType": "application/x.dash.dpp.identifier"` |
| `byteArray: true` | Mark an array property as binary data (not a JSON array) | `"type": "array", "byteArray": true, "minItems": 32, "maxItems": 32` |
| `unique: true` | Index constraint: enforce uniqueness across all documents of this type | `{"name": "owner", "unique": true, "properties": [{"$ownerId": "asc"}]}` |
| `contested` | Index flag indicating the index value is subject to voting if contested | Used on DPNS `domain` type's `parentNameAndLabel` index |
| `mutable: false` | Document type schema flag: documents are immutable after creation | `"mutable": false` on social interaction docs |
| `indices[].properties[].asc/desc` | Index sort direction per property | `{"$createdAt": "asc"}` |
| `canBeDeleted` | Config JSON key: whether the contract supports deletion | Default: `false` |
| `readonly` | Config JSON key: whether the contract schema is immutable | Default: `false` (mutable) |
| `keepsHistory` | Config JSON key: whether contract version history is retained | Default: `false` |
| `documentsKeepHistoryContractDefault` | Config JSON key: default for document history keeping | Default: `false` |
| `documentsMutableContractDefault` | Config JSON key: default for document mutability | Default: `true` |
| `documentsCanBeDeletedContractDefault` | Config JSON key: default for document deletion | Default: `true` |
| `requiresIdentityEncryptionBoundedKey` | Config JSON key: encryption key storage requirement (0=Unique, 1=Multiple, 2=MultipleRefLatest) | Optional |
| `requiresIdentityDecryptionBoundedKey` | Config JSON key: decryption key storage requirement | Optional |
| `enum` constraint | JSON Schema pattern: restrict string to listed values | `"enum": ["active", "paused", "closed"]` |
| `pattern` constraint | JSON Schema pattern: regex validation for strings | `"pattern": "^https?://.+$"` or `"^[a-z0-9_]{1,63}$"` |
| `minLength / maxLength` | JSON Schema pattern: string length bounds | `"minLength": 1, "maxLength": 500` |
| `minimum / maximum` | JSON Schema pattern: integer value bounds | `"minimum": 1, "maximum": 5` (star rating) |
| `minItems / maxItems` | JSON Schema pattern: array size bounds (also byte array size) | `"minItems": 32, "maxItems": 32` (identifier) |
| `INITIAL_DATA_CONTRACT_VERSION` | Constant: first version of a newly created contract is always `1` | `pub const INITIAL_DATA_CONTRACT_VERSION: u32 = 1;` |
| `INITIAL_REVISION` | Constant: first revision of a newly created document is always `1` | `pub const INITIAL_REVISION: u64 = 1;` |
| `MAX_TOKEN_NOTE_LEN` | Constant: maximum length of a token note is `2048` bytes | `pub const MAX_TOKEN_NOTE_LEN: usize = 2048;` |
| `typeLocator` | JS SDK convention: `"appName.documentType"` string to identify a document type | `"dashpay.profile"`, `"dpns.domain"` |
| `nonce manager` | JS SDK pattern: `nonceManager.bumpIdentityNonce(identityId)` before creating contracts | Prevents replay attacks |
| `identityContractNonce` | JS SDK pattern: `nonceManager.bumpIdentityContractNonce(identityId, contractId)` before document transitions | Per-contract nonce tracking |
| Group power threshold | Multiparty action approval: sum of participating members' power must >= group.required_power | `total_power >= required_power` |
| Group min 2 members | Groups must have at least 2 members; max 256 per platform limits | Validated in `GroupV0.validate()` |
| Token ID derivation | `double_hash("dash_token" || contract_id || token_position_be_bytes)` | `calculate_token_id()` |
| Document ID derivation | `double_hash(contract_id || owner_id || type_name || entropy)` | `Document::generate_document_id_v0()` |
| Config preset pattern | Use `TokenConfigurationPreset` + `TokenConfigurationPresetFeatures` to quickly configure token governance | `TokenConfigurationPreset { features: WithMintingAndBurningActions, action_taker: ContractOwner }` |
